vulnerability_title: The contribute(...) function may be DoS

content_code_consistency.content_reasoning: contribute accepts any non-zero msg.value and adds each new address to _collectionContributors until MAX_CONTRIBUTORS (100) is reached, and the file has no way to remove addresses. An attacker using 100 addresses with 1 wei each can block all new contributors.
patterns_found: fixed contributor limit with no minimum contribution and no removal
issues: withdrawContribution is mentioned only in the fix review and does not exist in this audited version.

scsvs_classification.vulnerability_type: contributor limit filled with dust contributions
